name: createos-sandbox
description: Run ad-hoc, heavy, or untrusted code OFF your machine in disposable CreateOS Sandboxes. One-shot offload, parallel fanout across N boxes, instant scratch shell, a reusable box with file sync for live dev loops, port tunnel to localhost, public HTTPS expose, a graphical Linux desktop with computer-use (screenshot/click/type) and a live noVNC link, multi-box private-network clusters, BYO-S3 disk mounts, WireGuard VPN, snapshot/fork, pause/resume to park a warm box at zero compute cost, custom Dockerfile-built images so boxes boot pre-provisioned, and running another coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor) on your code inside a box against OpenRouter or any OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible provider. Big dirs auto-excluded from uploads; auto-installs the createos CLI if missing.
